title: ER_DUP_FIELDNAME with simple find on 0.2.10
body:
**Issue type:**

[x] bug report

**Database system/driver:**

[x] `mysql 5.7.24`

**TypeORM version:**

[x] `0.2.10`

**Steps to reproduce or a small repository showing the problem:**

Given the following two entities:
```ts
@Entity({ name: "payrolls" })
export class Payroll {
    @PrimaryGeneratedColumn()
    public id: number;
}

@Entity({ name: "payroll_payslips" })
export class PayrollPayslip {
    @PrimaryGeneratedColumn()
    public id: number;

    @Column({ name: "payroll_id" })
    public payrollId: number;

    @ManyToOne((type) => Payroll)
    @JoinColumn({ name: "payroll_id" })
    public payroll: Payroll;
}
```

And the following find:

```ts
dbConn.getRepository(PayrollPayslip).findOne(id, { relations: ["payroll"] });
```

I now receive `ER_DUP_FIELDNAME` after upgrading to 0.2.10

```
error: QueryFailedError: ER_DUP_FIELDNAME: Duplicate column name 'PayrollPayslip_payroll_id'
    at new QueryFailedError (<project_dir>/node_modules/typeorm/error/QueryFailedError.js:28:28)
    at Query.<anonymous> (<project_dir>/node_modules/typeorm/driver/mysql/MysqlQueryRunner.js:227:45)
    at Query.<anonymous> (<project_dir>/node_modules/mysql/lib/Connection.js:502:10)
    at Query._callback (<project_dir>/node_modules/mysql/lib/Connection.js:468:16)
    at Query.Sequence.end (<project_dir>/node_modules/mysql/lib/protocol/sequences/Sequence.js:83:24)
    at Query.ErrorPacket (<project_dir>/node_modules/mysql/lib/protocol/sequences/Query.js:90:8)
    at Protocol._parsePacket (<project_dir>/node_modules/mysql/lib/protocol/Protocol.js:278:23)
    at Parser.write (<project_dir>/node_modules/mysql/lib/protocol/Parser.js:76:12)
    at Protocol.write (<project_dir>/node_modules/mysql/lib/protocol/Protocol.js:38:16)
    at Socket.<anonymous> (<project_dir>/node_modules/mysql/lib/Connection.js:91:28)
    at Socket.<anonymous> (<project_dir>/node_modules/mysql/lib/Connection.js:502:10)
    at Socket.emit (events.js:182:13)
    at Socket.EventEmitter.emit (domain.js:441:20)
    at addChunk (_stream_readable.js:283:12)
    at readableAddChunk (_stream_readable.js:264:11)
    at Socket.Readable.push (_stream_readable.js:219:10)
```

SQL generated on `0.2.10` (this does not work):
```sql
SELECT
    DISTINCT `distinctAlias`.`PayrollPayslip_id` as "ids_PayrollPayslip_id"
FROM
    (
        SELECT
            -- other fields ommitted
            `PayrollPayslip`.`payroll_id` AS `PayrollPayslip_payroll_id`,
            `PayrollPayslip_payroll`.`id` AS `PayrollPayslip_payroll_id`
        FROM
            `payroll_payslips` `PayrollPayslip`
            LEFT JOIN `payrolls` `PayrollPayslip_payroll` ON `PayrollPayslip_payroll`.`id` = `PayrollPayslip`.`payroll_id`
        WHERE
            (`PayrollPayslip`.`id` = 62)
    ) `distinctAlias`
ORDER BY
    `PayrollPayslip_id` ASC
LIMIT
    1
```

SQL generated on `0.2.9` (this works):
```sql
SELECT
    -- other fields ommitted
    `PayrollPayslip`.`payroll_id` AS `PayrollPayslip_payroll_id`,
    `PayrollPayslip_payroll`.`id` AS `PayrollPayslip_payroll_id`
FROM
    `payroll_payslips` `PayrollPayslip`
    LEFT JOIN `payrolls` `PayrollPayslip_payroll` ON `PayrollPayslip_payroll`.`id` = `PayrollPayslip`.`payroll_id`
WHERE
    (`PayrollPayslip`.`id` = 62)
```
